title: Paperclip accepts a payload, drops fields, and answers 200 with the object unchanged

incident.mechanism: a confirmed CLASS, not a pair of one-offs: PATCH /api/agents/{id} with instructionsBundle is dropped; issue executionWorkspace* fields are deleted outright when enableIsolatedWorkspaces is off. Both return 200. Any client that believes a status code records desired state it never achieved.

trigger: a server that returns 200 and does not persist the written field
assertion: mutate re-reads and throws; and the allowlist refuses an out-of-scope field before any write happens
